findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 法律程序：LUNA 事件與紐約州檢察長和解，未列反壟斷調查；應計法律準備 $151M（2025 年底），未折現和解額 $200M，2025–2028 分期支付。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: LUNA matters: On March 27, 2025, Galaxy reached an agreement with the New York State Attorney General to resolve civil claims related to certain investments, trading, and public statements made in connection with the LUNA digital asset from late 2020 to 2022.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素提及 AI 產業（含 AI/HPC 資料中心）受監管機構對市場集中與反競爭行為的關注，屬一般性風險揭露，非針對 Galaxy 的調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: AI and related industries are under increasing scrutiny from regulators due to their concerns about market concentration, anti-competitive practices, and the pace of partnerships and acquisitions involving generative AI startups.

findings.claim: 搜尋未見針對 Galaxy 的反壟斷（DOJ/FTC/EU）調查或拆分風險。

note: 只下 1 次搜尋；未見反壟斷調查。
